Guidance & outlook: According to Provisional Estimates released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), real GDP grew by 7.7% in FY 26, up from 7.1% in FY 25, while nominal GDP expanded by 8.9% - reaﬃrming India's position as one of the world's fastest-growing large economies.
As our development pipeline becomes operational, annual exit rentals are expected to increase from ₹6,501 mn in FY 26 to approximately ₹40,796 mn by FY 30, representing a CAGR of 58%.

Other income Other income has increased by 32.12% to ₹ 5,101 mn in FY 26 against ₹ 3,861 mn in FY 25 due to net gains on ﬁnancial assets designated as fair value through proﬁt or loss (FVPL) of ₹ 1,408 mn in FY 26 as against ₹ 165 mn in FY 25.
Growth & demand: Gross Fixed Capital Formation grew by over 8%, reﬂecting sustained investment-led Private consumption contributed nearly 60% of GDP Domestic demand continued to power economic growth.
We are targeting 15-20% growth in pre-sales, supported by a robust launch pipeline with an estimated GDV of over ₹570,000 mn, together with a substantial inventory pipeline.
Threats and Mitigation Outlook 15-20% targeted pre-sales growth Supported by a strong launch pipeline.
Margins & costs: This momentum was reﬂected in revenue, which grew by 70.58% year-on-year to ₹131,955 mn, EBITDA increased by 43.27% to ₹42,192 mn with the EBITDA margin standing at 31.97%.
131,955 mn, EBIDTA of ₹ 42,192 mn and PAT of ₹ 13,054 mn, EBIDTA margin stood at 31.97% and PAT margin stood at 9.89%.
EBIDTA margin stood at 38.07 % and PAT margin stood at 7.97 %.
Capex & expansion: 7.7% GDP Growth Management Discussion & Analysis momentum and continued infrastructure-led expansion across urban corridors.

On December 10, 2025, Prestige Falcon Realty Private Limited and Prestige Projects Private Limited, subsidiaries of the Company have acquired 66.93% partnership interest in Bharatnagar Buildcon LLP.
Balance sheet & cash: Borrowing Gross Borrowings have increased by 41.38% to ₹ 149,861 mn as at 31 March 2026 against ₹ 106,002 mn as at 31 March 2025.

DIVIDEND: The Board of Directors of the Company have recommen ded a dividend of ₹ 2 (20%) per Equity Share of ₹ 10/- ea ch which is subject to approval of shareholders in the ensuing Annual General Meeting of the Company.
